visual_action: Congresswoman Katie Porter stands in front of a white board. She speaks to the camera, then turns and writes 'Your vote' and 'Your voice' on the board with a black marker. She then turns back to the camera to finish her message.

cast.name: Katie Porter
cast.evidence: She is the only person on screen, is identified by face-ID, and introduces herself by saying, 'Hi, I'm Congresswoman Katie Porter.'

on_screen_text.text: and I have a message for you today.

spoken_summary: Congresswoman Katie Porter introduces herself and delivers a direct message to viewers, stating, "Your vote is your voice. Make sure you use it."
audio_music: The video features only spoken dialogue from Katie Porter, with no background music or sound effects.
editing_pacing: The video is a single, static shot with no cuts or edits, in a talking-head format.
central_claim: Citizens should vote because their vote is their primary political voice.
intended_effect: To encourage and motivate viewers to vote in elections.
